records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of September 30, 2023, the Company had $1.3 billion unused capacity of its facility under the Programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net reversals during the three months ended September 30, 2023 included reversals of prior year general provisions for economic factors related to the pandemic and a specific provision for a certain customer, partially offset by provisions for the current quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase is primarily related to obligations for energy commitments, partially offset by obligations to purchase lower quantities of agricultural commodity inventories.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Write-offs against allowance in the nine months ended September 30, 2023 were related to a customer in Brazil and allowance on receivables that were subsequently sold.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Based on the Company’s historical ability to generate sufficient cash flows from its U.S. operations and unused and available U.S. credit capacity of $7.1 billion, the Company has asserted that these funds are indefinitely reinvested outside the U.S.
